title: Cannoli v1.0.1 — Market hub, notifications & announcements
body:
- Trade Block and Free Agents are now one Market hub — shared budget/deadline header, list or unlist mons on the block, and a single trade composer with a live legality meter (feature)
- New notifications bell collecting announcements, What's New, and updates on feedback you reported (feature)
- Announcements can post as a site-wide banner, in the notifications bell, or both — targetable by league or role, editable, with a full history of everything sent (feature)
- Send categorized feedback with screenshots, and get notified when it's resolved (feature)
- Collapsible sidebar — icon rail with league flyouts on desktop, slide-in drawer on mobile (feature)
- The sim client now shows the live site announcement in its news pane (feature)
- Sim battle rooms for every league self-heal and stay available after reseeds or restarts (fix)
- Trade pickers show team names instead of internal ids (fix)
- The What's New bell clears reliably, even for entries dated slightly ahead (fix)
- Replay viewer scales the battle stage to fill the embed (improvement)

title: Cannoli 1.0 — Day 1 patch
body:
- Season 11 is live on the new National Dex+ scaling, rules synced (feature)
- Pick which week a battle counts for — play ahead or make up matches (feature)
- Nickname your Pokemon from the new Manage Roster panel (feature)
- Unified draft-pool search by name, type, move, ability or cost (feature)
- Watch every Season 9–11 replay in-app (feature)
- Upload a custom team logo (feature)
- Complete National Dex+ types and learnsets — tier list and coverage fixed (fix)
- Edit tera captains and tera types any time during the season (fix)
- Matchup Center is public — scout without signing in (improvement)
- Animated login and replay backgrounds, 3D sidebar gems (improvement)
- Smoother recovery after updates, with new error tracking (improvement)
